reviewMethod: Manual pairwise review in the local storefront browser. Similarity hashes were used only to order the queue and never to make a merge decision.

policy.exact: Same product, same finish/configuration, duplicate or equivalent image; source image is hidden after merge.
policy.variant: Same product geometry with a color, finish, or documented matching piece/angle; source image stays visible in the keeper gallery.
policy.reject: A material geometry, construction, base, surface shape, or product-type difference was found.
